changeSet.author: openelisglobal
changeSet.comment: Provider results name the panel sample they answer

changeSet.author: openelisglobal

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'uk_eqa_result_dist_org_test'

changeSet.comment: A result tied to a panel sample is unique per sample; one with no sample (a V1 row, or a scheme whose panel sealed nothing for that test) stays unique per test. One constraint over a nullable column cannot say both, because Postgres treats every NULL as distinct.

changeSet.author: openelisglobal
changeSet.comment: External PT results name the provider sample they answer and keep its target

changeSet.author: openelisglobal

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname = 'clinlims' AND indexname = 'uq_eqa_participant_result_round_lab_analyte'

changeSet.comment: External PT is one result per analyte per provider sample per round. A result with no sample code keeps the old one-per-analyte rule, because COALESCE maps every missing code to the same key; a bare NULL column would be distinct from every other NULL and stop enforcing it.
